summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian financial holding company, filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, containing a notice dated September 1, 2026, that it had made the dividend payment scheduled for September 2026 in accordance with the profit distribution proposal approved by shareholders on March 27, 2026. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of a scheduled dividend payment with no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing discloses no deal terms, board recommendations, or unusual mechanics. What to watch: no further action is anticipated; this is informational only.
